pages.text: Seraph Plate, forged from diamond armour and Starmetal under Stella light. Its halo and light-wings grow with every awakening. The full set mends you under the night sky; awakened, it glides while you sneak and flings you forward as the glide begins; ascended, you no longer fear falls.
The Starlight Aegis, a Starmetal shield. Every blocked blow brings it closer to waking.
